title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy without default-src
description: A policy omits its default-src fallback. Security teams often add script-src and object-src first and never add the fallback; the omitted directives stay unrestricted, so the effective policy is far weaker than the header text suggests.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk: Unnamed directives remain unrestricted; MEDIUM severity.
